heading: Duffy expects US flights to return to normal before Thanksgiving
body: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy says he expects air travel to return to normal ahead of the busy Thanksgiving holiday period, despite widespread disruption caused by the nationwide flight shutdown.

heading: ‘This is not the fault of the airline’: Duffy says FAA responsible for US flight shutdown
body: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy says the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), rather than commercial airlines, bears responsibility for the nationwide flight shutdown that left thousands of passengers stranded.

heading: JetBlue cancels all remaining flights of evening
body: US airlines JetBlue has cancelled all remaining flights of the evening with the exception of Europe-bound departures from John F Kennedy Airport in New York and Boston, the said in a statement.

heading: Turkiye-Qatar pact could bring Turkish air defences to Doha
body: The new Turkiye-Qatar defence agreement could pave the way for Turkish air defence systems to be deployed to Qatar, according to Yusuf Alabarda, an international security and political analyst and columnist for Turkiye’s Aksam daily newspaper.
